# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.5.4-beta

Per-parent requirement decomposition and stage work-product organization, building on the serial governance introduced in 0.5.3. See the bilingual [stage organization guide](https://github.com/zju-CS-yzy/ipd-agent-workflow-skill/blob/v0.5.4-beta/docs/stage-organization.md).

- Explicit registry 1.1 / contract 0.5.4 adoption retains a hashed prior snapshot. Old 0.5.3 registries keep their behavior; older clients reject new contracts.
- Hierarchical numbering separates readable ancestry from stable canonical identity. Existing IDs and historical mappings remain intact.
- Stage plans organize one IR→SR argument per IR and one SR→AR argument per SR, child registers, shared materials, stage indexes and TR4 delivery conclusions.
- Supporting versions and shared consumers participate in readiness, review manifests, impact and verification contexts. Narrative support edges do not silently become core execution dependencies.
- A read-only work-product Dashboard adds stage/increment filters, per-parent grouping, reverse usage and links to core Deliverables and historical snapshots.
- Pack 1.3.0 provides 23 original Markdown types in both languages. Pack 1.2.1 and older stay resolvable. Explicit instance revision creates a new file and preserves the old one.

### Compatibility

Legacy registries remain readable without adoption. Adopting organization uses a fingerprinted, authorized plan and preserves prior inputs. Old clients reject registry contract 0.5.4.

### Approval boundary

Keep one active increment, Claim and Review subject. Template completion, numbering and structural readiness do not approve a requirement or Gate. Human authorization remains a local explicit declaration, not authenticated platform approval mapping. Adopt in a new increment when existing work has already been accepted; no automatic split, ID rewrite, path movement or historical reapproval occurs.

### Known limitations

Markdown is supported. Native DOCX/XLSX, bulk historical path migration, concurrent governance, advanced cross-baseline browsing and independent content correctness are separate versions. Public synthetic qualification does not establish private Golden or real-project acceptance. Windows source builds may require a short path on hosts with legacy path limits. Publication requires successful tests for this Tag; completed qualification is recorded separately from prepublication source notes.

### 兼容性

显式采纳 Schema 1.1 / 契约 0.5.4，保留原登记快照；旧 ID 与历史版本不变，以独立可读编号表达当前父层级。TR2 按 IR、TR3 按 SR 组织分解论证与多行需求表，同一 IR 下的 SR 归组。阶段索引、其他专业交付件与共享支撑材料通过明确输入/支撑/输出关系贯通就绪检查、评审、验证和只读 Dashboard。

模板包 1.3.0 包含 23 类中英文 Markdown 模板，旧包继续可解析。覆盖变化时显式修订到新实例和新文件，不覆盖历史。

### 审批边界

保持单 Claim、单评审对象和明确人类批准；结构就绪不等于批准，授权声明也不等于经过平台认证的身份。

### 已知限制

DOCX/XLSX、历史批量路径迁移和并发治理继续在后续范围。私有 Golden 与真实项目验收不以公开合成测试代替；存在旧式路径长度限制的 Windows 环境可使用 wheel 或短源码目录。
